DELTA.purpose: detect and type the difference between current state and desired state
DELTA.exit_gate: every material absence is either bound to evidence or explicitly TOKEN_VAZIO

STAR.purpose: route each object through the correct operational window and authority path
STAR.exit_gate: each actionable object has exactly one primary route and explicit dependencies

MICRO_PER_MILLE.purpose: execute bounded micro-iterations with measurable change and regression control
MICRO_PER_MILLE.exit_gate: micro-batch has explicit result, no hidden regression, and unresolved uncertainty remains typed

OMEGA.purpose: declare a bounded operational plateau, never metaphysical or absolute completion
OMEGA.exit_gate: plateau is reproducible enough for the stated scope; any new material gap reopens DELTA

label_rule: discovery labels alter triage and routing but never constitute evidence or epistemic promotion

priority_function.rule: priority must be explained by dimensions and dependencies; urgency alone cannot bypass safety or evidence gates

six_sigma_boundary: Six Sigma terminology is used as process-improvement instrumentation; no sigma-level claim is allowed without measured defects, opportunities, sampling plan and receipt.
F_next: validate this lifecycle contract against adversarial fixtures and bind one real open gap end-to-end through DELTA->STAR->MICRO_PER_MILLE->OMEGA without claim promotion
